title: Flex and Fire Program
author: Mike Fitz 💪
desc:
This 4-day training split is built for women who want more than just “toned arms” or endless cardio. This program is designed to:

Build real strength without bulking
Shape glutes, legs, shoulders, and arms for a confident, feminine physique
Improve posture, core stability, and joint health
Rebuild energy and metabolism through muscle, not starvation
Fit into a busy schedule with smart, focused workouts

Each workout blends machine and free weight movements for joint-friendly progress, while still building the foundation for long-term muscle growth and metabolic health. 

Glutes and posture are prioritized.

Consistency is everything!

ex.note: You should feel these in your side delts. Use lighter weight. If you are feeling it in your neck you are using too much weight

ss.note: Really squeeze your elbows together. This will be super set with reverse pec deck. Finish your Pec Deck, take 30 second break then flip around and do reverse peck deck.
You should feel this in rear delts: don't go too heavy

ex.note: Go heavy on these - 8-12 reps. If you can do more than 12 reps, increase weight.
Get a good stretch with these.
Do as many as you can - go to failure! This is a finisher set. Chest should feel great after this!
I prefer you using a barbell but dumbbells will work too! Use wrist straps if you need them for grip. Keep butt out - this is to work your glutes/hams and not quads as much.
Can use machine here instead if desired. Work those hams and glutes!

ss.note: Superset the adductor and abductor. Finish set, rest 30 secs then go to abductor

ex.note: Remember this is to work your rear delts and upper back. Get a good squeeze with your shoulder blades. You shouldn't feel it in your biceps predominantly.
Put knee on bench and weight on ground. Slowly lift weight up and keep elbow back and down. Should feel in your lats and not in your bicep as much.
We want a wide grip with the cable row.
Start this day with leg extension. Squeeze at the top and hold for 2 seconds. This is a great warm up exercise to start leg day.
Don't be intimidated by this machine - Hack squat will protect your back and put the weight where it's supposed to be. If hack squat isn't available try leg press instead.
